findings.detail: Option B and its reason call the misplaced weights a structural output error. The guide (4.4-K4) names wrong field placement as a semantic validation error, and the reason for option D says the same thing. The question therefore labels the same failure two different ways, and option B's label disagrees with the guide.

The answer rests on the same reasoning as M2-S54-T1 and M3-S07-T4: retry succeeds when the information is in the source, and fails when it exists only in a document the system never receives. Two wrong options also repeat earlier ones. Option A (a failure will simply recur, so send it to human review) matches the M2 options claiming retries cannot fix failures or that failures persist. Option D (tool use with JSON schemas already eliminates such errors) matches option C of M3-S07-T4.

blind_answer.reason: The weights are present in the manifest, so the failure is a semantic or structural placement error. Retrying with specific validation feedback can correct it. Retries only fail when the information is absent from the source, as with the customs declaration case, which does not apply here.
